kinds.name: House Cat
kinds.blurb: An ordinary cat, which is to say: in charge.

kinds.name: Ember
kinds.blurb: Coal on the outside, lava in the cracks. Warm lap, scorched sofa.

kinds.name: Koi
kinds.blurb: Wears a pond's worth of patches and leaves bubbles where it walks.

kinds.name: Bloom
kinds.blurb: Grows a ruff of petals and turns to face the sun.

kinds.name: Static
kinds.blurb: Fur on end, sparks in the whiskers. Do not pet on a carpet.

kinds.name: Frost
kinds.blurb: Rimed fur and shards of ice at its back. Sleeps on the radiator anyway.

kinds.name: Stone
kinds.blurb: Carved a long time ago and has not moved since. The moss is winning.

kinds.name: Shroom
kinds.blurb: Sprouted overnight, under a spotted cap.

kinds.name: Slime
kinds.blurb: Mostly liquid, like every cat, only more so.

kinds.name: Bone
kinds.blurb: What is left of a cat, and still curious.

kinds.name: Imp
kinds.blurb: Horns, wings and bad ideas.

kinds.name: Seraph
kinds.blurb: Winged, haloed and entirely innocent of the vase.

kinds.name: Cyclops
kinds.blurb: One eye, two feelers, from somewhere else.

kinds.name: Mech
kinds.blurb: Wind the key in its back and it purrs at fifty hertz.

kinds.name: Dragon
kinds.blurb: Scales, horns, wings and a hoard under the sofa.

kinds.name: Void
kinds.blurb: The dark, with two eyes in it.

kinds.name: Galaxy
kinds.blurb: A night sky with a nebula in it. Do not wake.

kinds.name: Ghost
kinds.blurb: Pale, quiet, and you can see the wall through it.

kinds.name: Golden
kinds.blurb: Precious metal all the way through. It knows.

kinds.name: Nimbus
kinds.blurb: A small cloud that came down to sit. It rains a little.

kinds.name: Plush
kinds.blurb: Patched, stitched, button-eyed and much loved.

kinds.name: Bun
kinds.blurb: Baked this morning. The cuts in the crust are natural.

kinds.name: Lantern
kinds.blurb: A pumpkin with a candle in it and a grin carved out.

kinds.name: Unicorn
kinds.blurb: A horn of gold and a tail in every colour.

kinds.name: Ice
kinds.blurb: Cut from clear ice. Leaves a puddle where it naps.

kinds.name: Fruit
kinds.blurb: One of your five a day.

kinds.name: Reptile
kinds.blurb: Scales, a crest of spines and a tongue to taste the air.
